Official source: https://github.com/openai/sign-in-with-chatgpt-devkit/blob/0a36fefeb913055c8c7a1a29b63d82b96b2e841a/assets/brand/chatgpt-button-white-21.svg

Original SHA-256: `568ce2e8701934856aaafc0ed1c3d0300f6c2ff384d0ae743dd1dea08570e12c`.
